map.如何使用注意力计算量？: How do I use Attention FLOPs?
map.注意力计算量适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Attention FLOPs best for?
map.单层 FLOPs ≈ 2S²d (QKᵀ) + 2S²d (AV) = 4S²d: Single-layer FLOPs ~ 2S²d (QKᵀ) + 2S²d (AV) = 4S²d; total model GFLOPs = single-layer x layers / 10⁹
map.自注意力的两次矩阵乘各为 S×S×d 规模，乘加各算一次故乘 2，合计 4S²d: The two self-attention matrix multiplies are each SxSxd in size; multiply-add counts once each so x2, totaling 4S²d, growing quadratically with sequence length - exactly why long-context cost explodes. Linear and sparse attention exist to break this S² term.
map.注意力和序列长度平方相关，长序列代价高。: Attention scales with sequence length squared, so long sequences are costly.
map.单头注意力 FLOPs≈2·S²·d（QKᵀ 与 AV 两次矩阵乘），S 为序列: Single-head attention FLOPs ~ 2·S²·d (the QKᵀ and AV matrix multiplies), where S is sequence length and d is dimension.
map.多头总计算≈2·S²·h·d_head + 4·S·d²（含 Q/K/V/O 投: Multi-head total ~ 2·S²·h·d_head + 4·S·d² (including Q/K/V/O projections); the S² term makes compute grow quadratically with long sequences.
map.与 FFN 相比，注意力在长序列时 dominated by S²，是推理成本优: Compared with the FFN, attention is dominated by S² for long sequences and is the key target for inference-cost optimization.
map.S=1024, h=16, d_head=64(总 d=1024)：S² 项≈2: S=1024, h=16, d_head=64 (total d=1024): the S² term ~ 2x1024²x1024 ~ 2.15x10⁹ FLOPs; projections 4·S·d² = 4x1024x1024² ~ 4.29x10⁹. One layer ~ 6.4x10⁹ FLOPs, 12 layers ~ 7.7x10¹⁰.
map.为什么长文本推理特别慢？: Why is long-text inference especially slow?
map.注意力核心项是 S²·d，序列翻倍算力翻约 4 倍；KV 缓存虽降重算，但注意力: The core term is S²·d; doubling the sequence quadruples compute. KV cache cuts recompute but the attention matrix still grows with context length squared, so long-context cost rises sharply.
map.FLOPs 和显存是一回事吗？: Are FLOPs and memory the same thing?
map.不是。FLOPs 衡量算力(时间)，显存衡量参数与激活的存储(空间)。量化降显存: No. FLOPs measure compute (time); memory measures storage of parameters and activations (space). Quantization lowers memory but not FLOPs; sparsity/distillation can lower both.
